primary_instrument_rule: ETH chosen before inspecting any fitted parameter or fit result, never choose the best scoring instrument
gate: unchanged DEFAULT_GATE in lob/zi_calibration.py and each cohort protocol.json
evaluation_order: freeze all three train-only fits, evaluate August validation, then evaluate unopened September holdout exactly once
interpretation: Per-instrument fits separate representative tick heterogeneity from simulator misspecification; short simulated paths cannot establish full-day or tail fidelity. A failed gate remains failed and bounds the execution study to that synthetic simulator.
